_about: Library masters and what feeds each (founder, 15 Nov: keep the library current on need, not on a timer, in the most token-efficient way). tools/library-freshness.py marks a living document 'behind' when a feed changed after the document's last commit; history documents are never checked. 'name' matches the board's Library row. 'feeds' are git pathspecs from the repository root; 'feed_grep' (optional) counts only feed commits whose changed lines match it (git log -G). An artifact or local-only document has no git date, so 'refreshed' (IST date and time) is its last refresh, updated by whoever refreshes it. A source document (feeds empty) is current by definition.
